pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: One gray tick, not two. Where's your message right now?
A clock: still on your phone, not sent yet.
One tick: sent. Friend offline? WhatsApp's servers keep it, encrypted, up to thirty days.
Phone back on? Two ticks: delivered, and the server deletes its copy.
Our bad-link test: send-once delivered three of twenty; store-and-forward, all twenty.
Building chat? Hold every message until the next stop confirms it.
